notes: Median of three wall-clock calls after one warm-up; inputs fixed by seed 1301. Spacing 10 m, dt 0.001 s, order 4, 12-cell PML. Metal timing includes process startup, shader compilation and file I/O. Memory MB is decimal; MLX RSS is the parent lifetime high-water mark. Child RSS is a cumulative high-water statistic, so its delta is not an individual child peak. Relative difference is maximum absolute error divided by reference peak amplitude.
